args.reason: The old decision forbids writing secrets to .faff/ at all, not only committing them. Caching resolved API keys in .faff/cache/credentials.json writes plaintext secrets to disk under .faff/, which the old decision explicitly prohibits; gitignore only addresses the repo half of the rule. The why does not show the old rationale has stopped holding, and the claimed gain (avoiding process.env reads, which are in-memory) is negligible next to an LLM call. The supersession argument is unsound.
